recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist album cover featuring a detailed black-and-white pencil sketch of a man and woman's faces in close proximity, set against a stark white background with bold, centered sans-serif typography at the top and secondary tracklists flanking the central image.
coreVisualRelationships: The central portrait is the primary focal point, anchored by the white negative space.
The bold blue and gold text at the top creates a horizontal header that balances the verticality of the faces.
Small-scale tracklists on the left and right create a symmetrical frame for the central illustration.
coreInvariants: Fine-line pencil or charcoal texture in the illustration
Three-tiered centered typography at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized portrait of two figures, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, slightly overlapping.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the male figure, which are positioned near the horizontal center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starting at the bold blue title, moving to the gold subtitle, then down to the detailed faces, and finally to the side tracklists.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central figures and text, emphasizing the clean, retro aesthetic.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) overall with low-saturation accents; the blue and gold are punchy but not neon.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to four primary colors: White, Black, Blue, Gold

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning for the main title
All-caps for primary and secondary headers
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard geometric proportions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family with varying weights and colors to distinguish hierarchy.

preserve: Color distinction between title and subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the primary title.
Provides the necessary vertical presence and density.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail pencil sketch of a man and woman's faces, looking forward with gentle smiles. The style should be fine-line charcoal or graphite on a pure white paper background. Leave the top 25% of the frame completely empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-line centered text block at the top. Top line: Large, sky blue, heavy sans-serif. Second line: Medium, muted gold, bold sans-serif. Third line: Small, muted gold, regular sans-serif. Add two small blocks of blue text on the left and right mid-sections.

verificationChecks: Is the illustration rendered in a pencil/sketch style?
Are the blue and gold colors distinct and flat?
Is the typography centered and all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue and gold
mustRedesign: Any background textures or colors other than white
postGenerationChecks: The text does not overlap the faces.
The sketch style is consistent across both figures.
The white space feels intentional and not empty.
The color palette remains restricted to the specified four colors.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered, high-contrast pencil portrait with a three-tier geometric sans-serif header on a stark white field.
